contract.source_database: outputs/统一数据底座_20261022/统一数据底座.sqlite
contract.source_choice: existing fixed eastmoney raw snapshot through 2026-10-21; no new market collection
contract.calculation_start_reason: Avoid the unbridged 2022-05-26 raw-price discontinuity in the available warmup; no claim that 2022 corporate actions are complete.
contract.price_change_definition: C[t+5]/O[t+1]-1, next observed session open to fifth observed session close; not a fill or trading-return claim
contract.price_handling: Unadjusted prices, segmented at the three known 2023+ ex-dates. Finite windows cannot cross segments, recursive states restart; no current qfq snapshot input.
contract.label_exclusion: Drop windows with a known ex-date between entry and outcome, inclusive; drop outcome ends after development_end before calculating their outcome values.

volume.denominator: previous n segment observations excluding current
volume.unit: same-provider native ratio; no stock/index unit conversion

contract.selection_policy: All registered rows reported in fixed order; no ranking, optimizing thresholds, or selecting a winning combination.
contract.frequency_policy: Development descriptive frequencies only, matched eligible-feature baseline for each signal. Report raw overlapping observation count and fixed every-fifth-anchor sensitivity; neither count is declared independent trials.
contract.interval_policy: No IID binomial confidence intervals or forecasts supplied in this engineering batch.
